prose: Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta and Oracle returned just 9.3% of their cash to shareholders in the first three quarters of 2026 - the smallest share in 15 years - even as they generated record cash, because AI spending is absorbing the difference, Reuters reports. The article is paywalled to the fetcher (HTTP 401), so the figures come from the feed's report of the piece.
highlights: Big five tech returned only 9.3% of cash to shareholders in 9M 2026, a 15-year low
Record cash generation is being absorbed by AI spending
basis: Techmeme summary of the Reuters report; Reuters returns HTTP 401 to the fetcher
